# The Guardian Ring

> An educational explainer in development about infrared satellite architecture, from orbit to a detector element. Public sources explain the physics; named civil instruments supply detailed specifications.

This is a development preview, not a launch announcement. The pages retain noindex and nofollow. Interactive levels are being completed and checked in sequence; the presence of a level in the explorer is not a claim that it is finished.

## Pages

- [Story](https://reedos.dev/guardian_ring/): The narrated journey, schematic illustrations, and evidence labels.
- [Explorer](https://reedos.dev/guardian_ring/visualizer.html): Light, Data, and Heat views with source-linked cards and independent mathematical examples.
- [Evidence](https://reedos.dev/guardian_ring/evidence.html): Source register, claim evidence, and verification status.
- [Method](https://reedos.dev/guardian_ring/method.html): Formulas, assumptions, and project scope.
- [Glossary](https://reedos.dev/guardian_ring/glossary.html): Terms used in the explainer.

## Evidence and scope

Figures are labeled Spec, Vendor, Reported, Calc., or Assumed. Follow each figure's evidence to its exact source location, formula, or assumption. Sources marked unchecked support no claim.

GOES-R ABI and Landsat TIRS-2 specifications belong to those named civil instruments. They do not describe military sensors. Generic spacecraft, optics, detector elements, links, and orbit positions are representative and not to scale.

The calculation examples concern general orbital geometry, vacuum light travel, ideal circular-aperture diffraction, and ideal blackbody radiation. Source photon radiance is not a detector count. Vacuum propagation time is not warning latency. No real sensor sensitivity, detection threshold, resolution, array format, false-alarm rate, coverage, or end-to-end performance is estimated.

Atmospheric absorption is qualitative. Molecular emission-band examples come from a civil combustion study. The explainer supplies no operational visibility or quantitative transmission model. Public ground-system references identify component roles, not software internals or current operational status.

## Publication statement

Personal educational project based on cited public sources. Not an official publication of my employer or of the agencies or companies discussed. Models are schematic; estimates and assumptions are identified.
